Q5630.reason: Classic P/O ratios assign ~3 ATP to NADH and ~2 ATP to FADH2, so one pair of each rephosphorylates 5 ATP.

Q5634.reason: Deadly force is privileged in tort when the actor reasonably believes he is under deadly attack, even if that belief is mistaken.

Q5642.reason: Most circulating lactate is taken up and oxidized by other tissues (lactate shuttle); the listed gluconeogenesis, urea, and renal routes are not the main fate.
